accepted.quote: For the reasons cited above, Committee Democrats oppose H.R. 2283, which would create a carveout grant program to funnel VA dollars to community providers of mental health, rather than investing them in VA's direct care system.
accepted.rationale: Takano opposes creating a community-provider grant program for veteran mental health instead of investing in VA direct care.

accepted.quote: Furthermore, the lack of claims also gives us less oversight into the quality and safety of care delivered by grantees--we will have no claims, no returned medical records, and no insight at all into whether veterans are actually receiving evidence-based treatments.
accepted.rationale: Takano argues the grant structure would reduce VA oversight of quality and safety of veteran care.
